evaluation_boundary: The threshold was chosen from label-free similarity statistics and hand checks of train/validation pairs only. No model exists, no score was computed, and no test text was displayed. The test split is read only through HeldOutGuard for a logged final evaluation.
grouping: campaign-level: texts linked at character 5-gram Jaccard >= 0.4 (the level at which hand checks still found reworded variants of one campaign) + synthetic template families
owner_decision: 5 November 2026: creating a proposed sms_split.v2 at similarity threshold 0.4 is approved, subject to final distribution and leakage checks; v1 and its metadata are preserved. Adoption for M4.3 awaits the owner's manual review.
